title: Idea?  Ai Game jam??
author: allpotatoes247
selftext:
Just thinking  are there any full AI game jam comps out there?

I've had a look, and the obvious first place I went was itch.io. There are a few on there, but they seem pretty limited. It got me thinking  could we host something from here, or build one ourselves? How many people would actually be up for it?

Just a thought   let me know what you lot think.

comments.author: grizzlyp00p
comments.body: I'd enter that. Browser is the format that works: https://sweatypanzer.com/

comments.author: allpotatoes247
comments.body: i bet be super simple to do as well, we just pick a day figure out the rules and theme etc create a poll and vote. winner becomes an AI god on here until the next one ??

comments.author: DonkeyFar5962
comments.body: I’d definitely be interested! I’m building [Zyplo.io](http://Zyplo.io), a platform for publishing and discovering small HTML games, and I hadn’t considered hosting a game jam before—but this sounds like a great fit. I’d be happy to explore the idea and help make it happen.
